blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 9001:2015 相較 2008 版的結構變化與術語對照 — Understand structural and terminology changes from ISO 9001:2008 to 2015
blocks.en: Understand the structural and terminology changes from ISO 9001:2008 to ISO 9001:2015

blocks.zh: 掌握「風險思維」取代「預防措施」的設計邏輯 — Grasp why risk-based thinking replaced the preventive action clause
blocks.en: Grasp why risk-based thinking replaced the preventive action clause

blocks.zh: 了解「文件化資訊」如何統合舊版 document/records/procedures — See how "documented information" consolidates legacy documentation terms
blocks.en: See how "documented information" consolidates the legacy terms documents, records and procedures

blocks.zh: 認識 ISO 9000 系列生態系（Annex B）對製藥 QMS 的參考價值 — Recognize the ISO 9000 family ecosystem and its relevance to pharma QMS
blocks.en: Recognize the ISO 9000 family ecosystem (Annex B) and its reference value for a pharmaceutical QMS

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.en: Annex A Overview A.1 Terminology A.2 Products and Services A.3 Interested Parties A.4 Risk-Based Thinking A.5 Applicability A.6 Documented Information A.7 Organizational Knowledge A.8 External Provision Annex B Related Standards

blocks.zh: 資訊性附錄A：新結構、術語與概念說明 | p52–p55
blocks.en: Informative Annex A: Clarification of the New Structure, Terminology and Concepts | p52–p55

blocks.zh: 解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 15378 包含 ISO 9001 的附錄？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 15378 include annexes from ISO 9001?

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的正文是「建立在 ISO 9001:2015 之上，加入製藥包裝的特殊要求」。因此 Annex A 和 B 直接來自 ISO 9001:2015，幫助 ISO 15378 使用者理解底層框架的邏輯。
blocks.en: The body of ISO 15378 is "built on ISO 9001:2015, with particular requirements added for pharmaceutical primary packaging." Annex A and Annex B therefore come directly from ISO 9001:2015 and help ISO 15378 users understand the logic of the underlying framework.

blocks.zh: 換句話說：讀懂 Annex A = 讀懂 ISO 9001:2015 的設計哲學。
blocks.en: In other words: understanding Annex A = understanding the design philosophy of ISO 9001:2015.

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：術語自由度
blocks.en: Important reminder: freedom of terminology

blocks.zh: 標準明確說明：組織不需要把內部文件全部改成 ISO 術語。例如製藥廠習慣用的 "SOP"、"batch record"、"specification" 都可以保留，只要其功能符合標準要求即可。
blocks.en: The standard states explicitly that the organization does not need to convert all its internal documents to ISO terminology. Terms familiar to pharmaceutical manufacturers, such as "SOP", "batch record" and "specification", can all be kept, as long as their function meets the requirements of the standard.

blocks.zh: A.1 Structure and Terminology — Table A.1 對照表
blocks.en: A.1 Structure and Terminology - Table A.1 Comparison

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 vs ISO 9001:2015 術語主要差異
blocks.en: Main terminology differences, ISO 9001:2008 vs ISO 9001:2015

blocks.zh: 術語改變背後的邏輯
blocks.en: The logic behind the terminology changes

blocks.zh: ISO 2015 版的術語變動不只是換名字，而是反映了 QMS 哲學的轉移：
blocks.en: The terminology changes in the 2015 edition are not just renaming; they reflect a shift in QMS philosophy:

blocks.zh: Products → Products and services：服務型組織（如 CRO、CDMO）被明確納入範圍
blocks.en: Products → Products and services: service organizations (such as CROs and CDMOs) are explicitly brought into scope

blocks.zh: Supplier → External provider：更廣義，涵蓋合約研究機構、外包服務商
blocks.en: Supplier → External provider: a broader term that covers contract research organizations and outsourced service providers

blocks.zh: Documented information：統合了四個概念（文件 / 程序 / 記錄 / 品質手冊），減少文件管理的行政負擔
blocks.en: Documented information: merges four concepts (documents / procedures / records / quality manual), reducing the administrative burden of document management

blocks.zh: Management representative 取消：責任分散到各職能，而非指定一人
blocks.en: Management representative removed: responsibility is distributed across functions rather than assigned to one person

blocks.zh: 製藥稽核員的關鍵對照
blocks.en: Key terminology mapping for pharmaceutical auditors

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 15 和 FDA 21 CFR Part 211 仍使用舊術語（如 "procedures"、"records"、"supplier"）。稽核時需理解對照關係：
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 15 and FDA 21 CFR Part 211 still use the older terms (such as "procedures", "records" and "supplier"). During audits you need to understand how the terms map to each other:

blocks.zh: 理解這個對照表，可以避免在跨稽核時產生不必要的混淆。
blocks.en: Understanding this mapping avoids unnecessary confusion in cross-standard audits.

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「分類夾」到「知識庫」
blocks.en: Analogy: from "filing folders" to a "knowledge base"

blocks.zh: 2008 版像是有五個不同的文件夾（SOP 夾、記錄夾、品質手冊、計劃書...），每個夾子有不同的管理規則。2015 版說：全部都叫「文件化資訊」，你自己決定要「維持（maintain）」還是「保留（retain）」哪些，重點是符合目的。
blocks.en: The 2008 edition was like having five separate folders (SOP folder, records folder, quality manual, plans...), each with its own management rules. The 2015 edition says: call all of it "documented information", and you decide which items to "maintain" and which to "retain"; what matters is that it fits its purpose.

blocks.zh: 為何明確加入「服務」概念 | p52
blocks.en: Why "services" were explicitly added | p52

blocks.zh: 對初級包裝材料廠的影響
blocks.en: Impact on primary packaging material manufacturers

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 的對象是製藥初級包裝材料製造商（如玻璃瓶、注射器、塑膠瓶蓋）。這些廠商除了供應實體產品，往往也提供：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 is aimed at manufacturers of pharmaceutical primary packaging materials (such as glass vials, syringes and plastic closures). Besides supplying physical products, these companies often also provide:

blocks.zh: 技術支援（材料相容性測試建議）
blocks.en: Technical support (e.g., recommendations on material compatibility testing)

blocks.zh: 包材設計服務
blocks.en: Packaging design services

blocks.zh: 客製化開發協議
blocks.en: Customized development agreements

blocks.zh: 2015 版明確將這些「伴隨服務」納入 QMS 管轄範圍。
blocks.en: The 2015 edition explicitly brings these "accompanying services" within the scope of the QMS.

blocks.zh: 服務特性 vs 產品特性
blocks.en: Service characteristics vs product characteristics

blocks.zh: 服務的關鍵差異：交付前無法完全驗證合規性（因為服務在「交付當下」才完成）。這與 GMP 的出廠放行邏輯不同，要求在設計階段就確保服務品質，而非僅靠事後檢查。
blocks.en: The key difference with services: compliance cannot be fully verified before delivery (because a service is only completed at the moment it is delivered). This differs from the GMP logic of release before shipment, and it requires service quality to be assured at the design stage rather than relying solely on after-the-fact inspection.

blocks.zh: 相關方需求與期望 (Clause 4.2) | p53
blocks.en: Needs and expectations of interested parties (Clause 4.2) | p53

blocks.zh: 「相關方」在製藥包裝供應鏈的範圍
blocks.en: Scope of "interested parties" in the pharmaceutical packaging supply chain

blocks.zh: 對 ISO 15378 適用的包裝材料廠商，相關方（stakeholders）可包括：
blocks.en: For packaging material manufacturers to which ISO 15378 applies, interested parties (stakeholders) can include:

blocks.zh: 直接客戶：製藥廠、CDMO
blocks.en: Direct customers: pharmaceutical manufacturers, CDMOs

blocks.zh: 監管機構：FDA、EMA、PMDA
blocks.en: Regulatory authorities: FDA, EMA, PMDA

blocks.zh: 最終使用者：患者（透過藥品安全）
blocks.en: End users: patients (through drug product safety)

blocks.zh: 供應商：原料玻璃廠、塑膠粒料供應商
blocks.en: Suppliers: raw glass manufacturers, plastic resin suppliers

blocks.zh: 認證機構：ISO / GMP 稽核單位
blocks.en: Certification bodies: ISO / GMP audit organizations

blocks.zh: 重要邊界：不等於無限擴大範圍
blocks.en: Important boundary: this does not mean unlimited expansion of scope

blocks.zh: 標準明確說明：識別相關方不代表 QMS 需要無限擴張以滿足所有相關方的每一項需求。組織有自主判斷哪些要求與 QMS 相關的權利。這個邊界說明對稽核時的 scope 討論非常重要。
blocks.en: The standard states explicitly that identifying interested parties does not mean the QMS must expand without limit to meet every requirement of every interested party. The organization has the right to decide on its own which requirements are relevant to the QMS. This clarification is very important in scope discussions during audits.

blocks.zh: 風險思維 — 取代「預防措施」條款的設計邏輯 | p53–p54
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking - the design logic that replaced the "preventive action" clause | p53–p54

blocks.zh: 為什麼 2015 版取消「預防措施」條款？
blocks.en: Why did the 2015 edition remove the "preventive action" clause?

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 的 Clause 8.5.3 是「預防措施（Preventive Action）」，要求識別潛在不符合並採取措施。但在實踐中，這個條款常被機械式執行（填表、開 PA，但沒有真正的風險分析）。
blocks.en: Clause 8.5.3 of ISO 9001:2008 was "Preventive Action", which required identifying potential nonconformities and taking action. In practice, however, this clause was often executed mechanically (filling in forms and opening PAs without any real risk analysis).

blocks.zh: 2015 版的做法更根本：把風險思維內建到整個 QMS 框架，特別是：
blocks.en: The 2015 edition takes a more fundamental approach: it builds risk-based thinking into the whole QMS framework, in particular:

blocks.zh: 4.1：理解組織情境
blocks.en: 4.1: Understanding the organization and its context

blocks.zh: 4.2：識別相關方需求
blocks.en: 4.2: Identifying the needs of interested parties

blocks.zh: 6.1：規劃時識別風險與機會
blocks.en: 6.1: Identifying risks and opportunities during planning

blocks.zh: 結果：QMS 本身就是一個持續性的「預防機制」，而非有一個獨立的預防措施表單系統。
blocks.en: The result: the QMS itself is a continuous "preventive mechanism", rather than a separate preventive-action form system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「滅火器」到「防火設計」
blocks.en: Analogy: from "fire extinguishers" to "fire-safe design"

blocks.zh: 舊版的預防措施像是在每個房間放滅火器（事後補救思維）。新版的風險思維像是從建築設計階段就規劃逃生動線、防火材料、灑水系統——把安全內建到結構裡，而不是靠工具補充。
blocks.en: The old preventive action was like placing a fire extinguisher in every room (an after-the-fact remedy mindset). The new risk-based thinking is like planning escape routes, fire-resistant materials and sprinkler systems from the building design stage: safety is built into the structure instead of being added on with tools.

blocks.zh: 與 ICH Q9 風險管理的關係
blocks.en: Relationship with ICH Q9 risk management

blocks.zh: 標準明確說：不要求正式的風險管理方法論或文件化的風險管理流程。這與 ICH Q9 的正式 FMEA/HACCP 方法不同——ISO 15378 的風險思維是「態度與判斷」，ICH Q9 是「工具與方法」。兩者互補，ISO 15378 不取代 ICH Q9。
blocks.en: The standard states clearly that it does not require formal risk management methodology or a documented risk management process. This differs from the formal FMEA/HACCP methods of ICH Q9: the risk-based thinking in ISO 15378 is an "attitude and judgment", whereas ICH Q9 provides "tools and methods". The two are complementary, and ISO 15378 does not replace ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: 對製藥包裝廠的實際影響
blocks.en: Practical impact on pharmaceutical packaging manufacturers

blocks.zh: 風險思維帶來的彈性包括：
blocks.en: The flexibility that risk-based thinking brings includes:

blocks.zh: 製程風險低的包材（如紙箱）文件化要求可較簡單
blocks.en: Packaging materials from low-risk processes (such as cartons) can have simpler documentation requirements

blocks.zh: 直接接觸藥品的包材（如注射器柱塞）需要更嚴格的文件化
blocks.en: Packaging materials in direct contact with the drug product (such as syringe plungers) require stricter documentation

blocks.zh: 組織可自主決定哪些風險評估需要保留記錄，哪些口頭確認即可
blocks.en: The organization can decide for itself which risk assessments need retained records and which can be confirmed verbally

blocks.zh: 適用性 — 取代舊版「豁免（Exclusions）」概念 | p54
blocks.en: Applicability - replacing the old concept of "Exclusions" | p54

blocks.zh: 「豁免」vs「不適用」的本質差異
blocks.en: The essential difference between "exclusion" and "not applicable"

blocks.zh: 2008 版允許在品質手冊中聲明「豁免（exclusion）」特定條款——但這導致一些組織直接略過與其業務相關的要求。
blocks.en: The 2008 edition allowed the quality manual to declare an "exclusion" of particular clauses, but this led some organizations to simply skip requirements that were relevant to their business.

blocks.zh: 2015 版改為：沒有「豁免」這個詞。你只能說某條款「不適用於你的 QMS 範疇」，且前提是這個決定不會影響產品/服務的合規性。
blocks.en: The 2015 edition changes this: the word "exclusion" no longer exists. You can only say that a clause is "not applicable to the scope of your QMS", and only on condition that this decision does not affect the conformity of products/services.

blocks.zh: 稽核實務關鍵點
blocks.en: Key audit practice points

blocks.zh: 當被稽核方聲稱某條款「不適用」時，稽核員應確認：
blocks.en: When an auditee claims that a clause is "not applicable", the auditor should confirm:

blocks.zh: 是否有書面理由說明為何不適用
blocks.en: Whether there is a written justification for why it is not applicable

blocks.zh: 該決定是否影響產品合規性
blocks.en: Whether the decision affects product conformity

blocks.zh: 是否在 QMS 範疇聲明（scope statement）中有所說明
blocks.en: Whether it is addressed in the QMS scope statement

blocks.zh: 這與舊版「品質手冊列豁免章節」的做法在形式和精神上都有所不同。
blocks.en: This differs from the old practice of "listing exclusion clauses in the quality manual" in both form and spirit.

blocks.zh: 文件化資訊 — 統合文件、程序、記錄、品質手冊 | p54
blocks.en: Documented information - consolidating documents, procedures, records and the quality manual | p54

blocks.zh: 品質手冊去哪了？
blocks.en: What happened to the quality manual?

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 正式取消了對「品質手冊」的強制要求。組織仍可選擇維持品質手冊，但這不再是標準的必要要求。對於已取得 ISO 15378 認證並有品質手冊的組織，只需確保其涵蓋範疇與標準要求的 documented information 一致即可。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 formally removed the mandatory requirement for a "quality manual". Organizations may still choose to maintain one, but it is no longer a required element of the standard. For organizations already certified to ISO 15378 that have a quality manual, it is enough to make sure its coverage is consistent with the documented information required by the standard.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食譜 vs 烹飪記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: recipe vs cooking log

blocks.zh: Maintain = 廚師手冊（食譜）：要保持最新版本，有人用時取出，修改後更新，舊版可以丟棄。Retain = 每日餐廳出菜記錄：每天的記錄都要保留，作為食安稽查的證明，不能任意處置。
blocks.en: Maintain = the chef's manual (recipes): keep the latest version, take it out when someone needs it, update it after changes, and discard old versions. Retain = the restaurant's daily service records: each day's records must be kept as proof for food safety inspections and cannot be disposed of at will.

blocks.zh: Maintain vs. Retain — 關鍵區分
blocks.en: Maintain vs. Retain - the key distinction

blocks.zh: 這是 2015 版最重要的文件管理概念之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important document management concepts in the 2015 edition:
Organizational knowledge - a new requirement in the 2015 edition (7.1.6) | p54–p55

blocks.zh: 組織知識 — 2015 版全新要求
blocks.en: Organizational knowledge - an entirely new requirement in the 2015 edition

blocks.zh: 這是 ISO 9001:2015 相比 2008 版最具創新性的新增要求之一。Clause 7.1.6 要求組織：
blocks.en: This is one of the most innovative additions of ISO 9001:2015 compared with the 2008 edition. Clause 7.1.6 requires the organization to:

blocks.zh: 確定所需的組織知識
blocks.en: Determine the knowledge it needs

blocks.zh: 維持這些知識（並提供給需要的人）
blocks.en: Maintain this knowledge (and make it available to those who need it)

blocks.zh: 當面對新需求時，考慮如何獲取知識
blocks.en: When addressing new needs, consider how to acquire knowledge

blocks.zh: 製藥廠常見的知識流失風險
blocks.en: Common knowledge-loss risks in pharmaceutical companies

blocks.zh: 對初級包裝材料製造商，以下情境需要特別注意：
blocks.en: For primary packaging material manufacturers, the following situations need particular attention:

blocks.zh: 資深製程工程師離職 → 特殊材料加工技術失傳
blocks.en: A senior process engineer leaves, and the specialized material processing know-how is lost

blocks.zh: 客戶規格歷史沿革未記錄 → 下次認證無法溯源決策依據
blocks.en: The history of customer specifications is not documented, so the basis for decisions cannot be traced at the next certification

blocks.zh: 稽核 finding 的根因分析結果未系統化 → 同類問題重複發生
blocks.en: Root cause analysis results from audit findings are not systematized, so similar problems recur

blocks.zh: 供應商變更評估的歷史資料散落各部門
blocks.en: Historical data from supplier change assessments is scattered across departments

blocks.zh: 比喻：組織記憶 vs 個人記憶
blocks.en: Analogy: organizational memory vs personal memory

blocks.zh: 如果關鍵知識只存在某位員工的腦袋裡，那不叫「組織知識」，那叫「人質風險」。7.1.6 的本質是要求把「人的知識」轉化為「組織的知識」。
blocks.en: If key knowledge exists only in one employee's head, it is not "organizational knowledge"; it is "hostage risk". The essence of 7.1.6 is to require that "individual knowledge" be turned into "organizational knowledge".

blocks.zh: 外部提供之製程、產品與服務的管控 (8.4) | p55
blocks.en: Control of externally provided processes, products and services (8.4) | p55

blocks.zh: 外部提供的三種形式
blocks.en: Three forms of external provision

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 在此擴展了管控對象，從「採購」延伸到更廣義的「所有形式的外部提供」：
blocks.en: ISO 15378 broadens the scope of control here, from "purchasing" to "all forms of external provision" in the wider sense:

blocks.zh: 採購（Purchasing）：向供應商購買原料、零件（傳統供應商管理）
blocks.en: Purchasing: buying raw materials and components from suppliers (traditional supplier management)

blocks.zh: 關聯公司安排：集團內跨廠區提供製程或服務
blocks.en: Arrangements with affiliated companies: processes or services provided across sites within a group

blocks.zh: 外包（Outsourcing）：將某一製程委託外部機構執行
blocks.en: Outsourcing: entrusting a process to an external organization to perform

blocks.zh: 風險思維決定管控程度
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking determines the extent of control

blocks.zh: 並非所有外部提供都需要相同強度的管控。風險導向評估：
blocks.en: Not all external provision needs the same intensity of control. Risk-based assessment:

blocks.zh: 直接接觸藥品的包材（如注射用玻璃瓶）→ 嚴格的供應商稽核、材料認證
blocks.en: Packaging materials in direct contact with the drug product (such as glass vials for injection) → rigorous supplier audits and material certification

blocks.zh: 辦公室清潔服務外包 → 合約約定即可，無需 GMP 稽核
blocks.en: Outsourced office cleaning services → contractual agreement is sufficient, no GMP audit needed

blocks.zh: 外包滅菌製程 → 接近 GMP 等級管控，需稽核能力
blocks.en: Outsourced sterilization process → control close to GMP level, audit capability required

blocks.zh: 這種比例原則的管控邏輯，與 ICH Q10 的 Quality Systems 精神一致。
blocks.en: This proportionate control logic is consistent with the spirit of the ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system.

blocks.zh: 資訊性附錄B：ISO/TC 176 發展的其他品質管理國際標準 | p56–p59
blocks.en: Informative Annex B: Other International Quality Management Standards Developed by ISO/TC 176 | p56–p59

blocks.zh: ISO/TC 176 是什麼？
blocks.en: What is ISO/TC 176?

blocks.zh: ISO Technical Committee 176 是負責制定所有 ISO 9000 系列標準的委員會。Annex B 列出的所有標準都出自這個委員會，形成一個「ISO QMS 生態系」。
blocks.en: ISO Technical Committee 176 is the committee responsible for developing all the standards of the ISO 9000 family. All the standards listed in Annex B come from this committee, forming an "ISO QMS ecosystem".

blocks.zh: 三個核心標準的定位：
blocks.en: The positioning of the three core standards:

blocks.zh: ISO 9000：字典（vocabulary 和 principles）
blocks.en: ISO 9000: the dictionary (vocabulary and principles)

blocks.zh: ISO 9001：法規（requirements，認證依據）
blocks.en: ISO 9001: the rulebook (requirements, the basis for certification)

blocks.zh: ISO 9004：進階指引（超越合規，追求卓越）
blocks.en: ISO 9004: advanced guidance (going beyond compliance, pursuing excellence)

blocks.zh: Annex B 的重要聲明
blocks.en: Important statement in Annex B

blocks.zh: 這些附加標準不增加、也不修改 ISO 15378 的要求。它們是選用工具，而非強制要求。對稽核員而言：Annex B 的標準不可作為稽核 finding 的直接依據。
blocks.en: These additional standards neither add to nor modify the requirements of ISO 15378. They are optional tools, not mandatory requirements. For auditors: the standards in Annex B cannot be used as a direct basis for an audit finding.

blocks.zh: ISO 9000 系列生態系地圖
blocks.en: Map of the ISO 9000 family ecosystem

blocks.zh: 以功能分類，幫助 QMS 專業人員選擇適合的工具：
blocks.en: Grouped by function, to help QMS professionals choose suitable tools:

blocks.zh: 基礎框架：ISO 9000（詞彙）、ISO 9001（要求）、ISO 9004（卓越）
blocks.en: Foundation framework: ISO 9000 (vocabulary), ISO 9001 (requirements), ISO 9004 (excellence)

blocks.zh: 客戶導向：ISO 10001-10004（客戶滿意系列）
blocks.en: Customer focus: ISO 10001-10004 (customer satisfaction series)

blocks.zh: 文件管理：ISO 10005（品質計劃）、ISO/TR 10013（文件指引）
blocks.en: Document management: ISO 10005 (quality plans), ISO/TR 10013 (documentation guidelines)

blocks.zh: 量測系統：ISO 10012（量測管理）、ISO/TR 10017（統計技術）
blocks.en: Measurement systems: ISO 10012 (measurement management), ISO/TR 10017 (statistical techniques)

blocks.zh: 人員發展：ISO 10015（訓練）、ISO 10018（人員能力）
blocks.en: Personnel development: ISO 10015 (training), ISO 10018 (people involvement and competence)

blocks.zh: 稽核：ISO 19011（稽核指引）
blocks.en: Auditing: ISO 19011 (guidelines for auditing)

blocks.zh: 顧問：ISO 10019（顧問選擇）
blocks.en: Consulting: ISO 10019 (selection of consultants)

blocks.zh: 製藥 QMS 最實用的三個
blocks.en: The three most useful for a pharmaceutical QMS

blocks.zh: 對 ISO 15378 的使用者而言，最具直接應用價值的附加標準：
blocks.en: For ISO 15378 users, the additional standards with the most direct practical value are:

blocks.zh: ISO 19011：供應商稽核計劃的設計指引——如何規劃稽核頻率、稽核員資格、稽核報告
blocks.en: ISO 19011: guidance for designing a supplier audit program, including how to plan audit frequency, auditor qualifications and audit reports

blocks.zh: ISO 10002：客訴處理流程——與 21 CFR Part 820 的 complaint handling 要求高度呼應
blocks.en: ISO 10002: complaint handling process, closely aligned with the complaint handling requirements of 21 CFR Part 820

blocks.zh: ISO 10015：人員訓練管理——支持 Clause 7.2 的能力管理要求
blocks.en: ISO 10015: management of personnel training, supporting the competence management requirements of Clause 7.2

blocks.zh: 比喻：本標準是主機，附加標準是 App
blocks.en: Analogy: this standard is the phone, the additional standards are apps

blocks.zh: ISO 15378 是手機作業系統（強制規定基本功能）。ISO 9000 系列的其他標準是 App Store 的應用程式——你可以根據需求選擇安裝，但不安裝也不違規，且它們不能修改作業系統的核心規則。
blocks.en: ISO 15378 is the phone operating system (it mandates the basic functions). The other standards in the ISO 9000 family are the apps in the App Store: you can install them as needed, but not installing them is no violation, and they cannot change the core rules of the operating system.

blocks.zh: Table B.1 解讀重點
blocks.en: Key points for reading Table B.1

blocks.zh: 從表格可以看出幾個模式：
blocks.en: Several patterns can be seen from the table:

blocks.zh: 全域相關（All × All）：ISO 9000、ISO 9004、ISO 10006、ISO 10008、ISO 10014、ISO 10018 — 這些標準的原則適用於整個 QMS 框架
blocks.en: Globally relevant (All × All): ISO 9000, ISO 9004, ISO 10006, ISO 10008, ISO 10014, ISO 10018 - the principles of these standards apply across the whole QMS framework

blocks.zh: 高度集中在 Clause 8（Operation）：ISO 10001、10002、10003、10004、10007 — 反映這些標準主要涉及運營層面（客戶互動、產品交付、技術管控）
blocks.en: Highly concentrated in Clause 8 (Operation): ISO 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004, 10007 - reflecting that these standards mainly concern the operational level (customer interaction, product delivery, technical control)

blocks.zh: Clause 9（評估）集中：ISO 10001-10004 都與 9.1.2（客戶滿意度監測）相關
blocks.en: Concentrated in Clause 9 (Evaluation): ISO 10001-10004 are all related to 9.1.2 (monitoring customer satisfaction)

blocks.zh: Clause 7.5 僅 ISO/TR 10013：文件化資訊管理的專屬指引
blocks.en: Clause 7.5 only ISO/TR 10013: the dedicated guidance on managing documented information

blocks.zh: ISO 19011 僅 9.2：稽核指引專注在「內部稽核」條款
blocks.en: ISO 19011 only 9.2: audit guidance focuses on the "internal audit" clause

blocks.zh: 如何使用 Table B.1？
blocks.en: How to use Table B.1

blocks.zh: 當你在改善 QMS 的某個領域時，Table B.1 告訴你哪些 ISO 標準有相關指引：
blocks.en: When you are improving a particular area of the QMS, Table B.1 tells you which ISO standards offer relevant guidance:

blocks.zh: 改善 Clause 7.5 文件管理 → 參考 ISO/TR 10013
blocks.en: Improving Clause 7.5 document management → refer to ISO/TR 10013

blocks.zh: 加強 Clause 9.2 內部稽核 → 參考 ISO 19011
blocks.en: Strengthening Clause 9.2 internal audit → refer to ISO 19011

blocks.zh: 優化 Clause 9.1.2 客戶滿意度 → 參考 ISO 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004
blocks.en: Optimizing Clause 9.1.2 customer satisfaction → refer to ISO 10001, 10002, 10003, 10004

blocks.zh: 強化 Clause 8.4 外部提供管控 → 參考 ISO 10019（顧問/服務商選擇）
blocks.en: Reinforcing Clause 8.4 control of external provision → refer to ISO 10019 (selection of consultants/service providers)

blocks.zh: 提升 Clause 7.2 人員能力 → 參考 ISO 10015
blocks.en: Raising Clause 7.2 personnel competence → refer to ISO 10015

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection exercise

blocks.zh: 你的組織目前在 ISO 15378 認證下最薄弱的條款是哪個？對應 Table B.1，找出最相關的 ISO 支援標準，評估是否值得導入其指引架構。
blocks.en: Which clause is currently the weakest point in your organization's ISO 15378 certification? Using Table B.1, find the most relevant supporting ISO standard and assess whether it is worth adopting its guidance framework.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節重點總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 稽核員提醒
blocks.en: Auditor reminder

blocks.zh: Annex A 的術語對照表是跨標準稽核的「翻譯字典」。EU GMP / FDA 使用的術語 (procedures, records, supplier) 可對應到 ISO 15378 的術語。理解這個對照可避免在混合稽核時的溝通誤解。
blocks.en: The terminology mapping table in Annex A is the "translation dictionary" for cross-standard audits. The terms used by EU GMP / FDA (procedures, records, supplier) can be mapped to ISO 15378 terminology. Understanding this mapping avoids miscommunication in combined audits.
